verses.1: O priest, let him approach the altar with incense and sacrifice, and let him draw near to the altar where the holy, pure offering is presented—not carnal flesh, but he himself; for God made the heaven holy and heavenly, and the true one that is offered, the precious water, because God made the heaven the water of life, and he gave it from the assembly of the priesthood. If he be cut off and separated from the house of the assembly, they shall be gathered into the congregation. And let the priest approach and offer upon the altar where the offering is presented; he shall be saved by water, for our God Christ says: 'I am he, the water of life.'
